messages:
olivia_s: Heads-up: we're seeing a sudden spike in fncall schema rejects on Dedicated (us-central). reject rate ~3.8% in the last 15m, error=unknown_field_deprecated

harry_t: Any common pattern in the payloads?

olivia_s: Quick sample from the traces: callers are sending a deprecated top-level `caller` key plus an unexpected nested `result_v2` union. Our validator now rejects unknown fields when strict_tool_schema=true. Example: 
```json
{
  \"tool_output\": { \"status\": \"ok\" },
  \"caller\": \"integration-x\",
  \"result_v2\": [ { \"value\": 1 } ]
}
expected: { \"tool_output\": object, \"meta\": object? }
```

ryan_m: This is also surfacing in billing: when validators reject, routing falls back to the degen route and we see spike in degen_compute_seconds. Ops noticed cost jump for one customer.

devops-bot: deploy: routing-policy/strict-validator route updated to 100% for Dedicated us-central by @ops. Commit: a7c9d3.

harry_t: Wasn't that supposed to be a gradual rollout?

olivia_s: It was. Looks like a templating bug in the rollout YAML made `percent: ${PERCENT:-100}` default to 100 in env when PERCENT unset.

ryan_m: Short term mitigation options: 1) set adapter-mode=strip_deprecated to silently remove `caller` and coerce `result_v2` -> `result` mapping (we'll increment fncall.adapter_coercions_total), 2) revert routing-policy target to 20%, 3) temporarily exempt retries from quota to avoid client retries blowing up cost.

harry_t: I prefer (2)+(1) for the immediate fix. We want to preserve signal about bad callers (don't fully hide), but avoid mass rejects and cost. Strip with a metric increment is reasonable.

olivia_s: I'll flip routing back and enable strip_deprecated=true in Dedicated us-central config. Also adding a console annotation at rollback time.

devops-bot: action: rollback routing-policy/strict-validator -> target_percentage=20% by @olivia_s.

olivia_s: Done. Toggled adapter.strip_deprecated=true in `/config/adapters/fncall/dedicated-us-central.json`. Also annotated console at ts=1741239999.

harry_t: Can you paste the PromQL panels we should add? Need per-route rejects and cost impact.

olivia_s: PromQLs: 
```
sum by(route) (rate(fncall_validate_rejects_total[5m]))
sum by(route) (rate(degen_compute_seconds_total[5m]))
sum by(caller) (rate(fncall_adapter_coercions_total[5m]))
```

harry_t: Add a derived panel `degen_cost_ratio = degen_compute_seconds / total_compute_seconds` so SRE can watch cost shift. Also alert: fire if rejects increase >0.4% absolute in 10m AND degen_cost_ratio > 0.2.

ryan_m: I'll open a billing tag for the affected account and contact the partner (integration-x). Also propose adding a honeytoken field `x-integration-id` that we inject into responses to make tracing top callers easier.

olivia_s: Filing ops ticket with sample traces and top caller list. Assigning to @ryan_m to reach out. I'll also add a short note in the console docs about `adapter.strip_deprecated` and the allowed shrinkwrap mappings.

harry_t: Docs PR and a small lint rule to catch rollout YAML defaulting to 100% would help avoid recurrence.

console-bot: annotation: rollback applied at 1741239999 by olivia_s -> `routing-policy` adjusted, adapter strip enabled.

olivia_s: TL;DR: accidental full rollout + stricter validator + deprecated keys triggered rejects -> rolled back to 20%, enabled adapter strip_deprecated (counts coercions), added dashboard queries and cost alert, ops ticket + partner outreach.

ryan_m: Thanks. We'll reconvene if rejects don't drop under 0.5% in 8m. :thumbsup:
